lines: - Serde is a framework for ser ializing and de serializing Rust data structures efficiently and generically. You may be looking for: An overview of Serde Data formats supported by Serde Setting up #[derive(Serialize, Deserialize)] Examples API documentation Release notes Serde in action use serde :: { Deserialize , Serialize }; #[derive( Serialize , Deserialize , Debug )] struct Point { x : i32 , y : i32 , } fn main () { let point = Point { x : 1 , y : 2 }; // Convert the Point to a JSON string. l
